text:
anya: Opening a compact thread for Closed-Loop Acceptance Criteria for the Private/Dedicated pilot. Goal: make GA decision deterministic after 60-8 weeks. Keep it short + measurable.
rachel: Agree. Recommend 3 waves (2 partners each) so we can fix things between waves. Wave cadence = 2 weeks each + 1-week analysis.
sam: Draft acceptance checklist (suggested):
- Onboarding SLA: provisioned and able to run inference < 10 business days
- Automation: automated preflight completes without manual remediation for >=3 partners
- Perf gate: 95th pct latency within SLO for 10 consecutive business days
- Reliability: no >1 P1 incident during pilot window
- Feedback: partner satisfaction >=8/10 on tech + product after week 6
- Data safety: telemetry opt-in and legal addendum signed, 0 data-exfil incidents
If all met, produce GA recommendation. If partially met, produce remediation backlog + re-run window.

lee: Ops specifics: provisioning SLA targets: VPC <= 3 business days, assisted on-prem <= 7 business days. Need expected avg/peak QPS from partners for capacity planning. Also we should require partners to confirm maintenance windows up front.
devon: Intake form (will wire to calendar & CS shortlist):
```
Company name:
Preferred deployment: VPC / on-prem
Avg QPS (per min):
Peak QPS expected:
95th token length estimate:
Infra maturity (1-5):
Willing to share anonymized logs? [ ] Y  [ ] N
Primary infra contact (name/email):
Exec sponsor (name/email):
Preferred handshake timeslot:
```
I'll include a scoring column that weights infra maturity and log-share willingness.

legal: Telemetry addendum: 90-day retention, no customer PII, aggregated reporting only. We need a checkbox on intake: "I consent to anonymized telemetry and agree to the 90-day retention addendum." I'll push a 2-paragraph template by EOD + a short checkbox string.

rachel: Compensation model: simple two-track: (A) credits for Hosted/Dedicated OR (B) X eng-hours for assisted on-prem. Keep paperwork lightweight, CS to sell with the ask.

cs-bot: cs-bot: Shortlist exported (11 candidates). Recommend initial outreach to top 8 with the intake link.

product-bot: Reminder: acceptance-criteria doc draft due by 1789133000. Use /calendar to book review.

anya: Owners & next actions: (1) devon publishes intake + scoring rubric by 1789131200, (2) lee publishes provisioning checklist + preflight POC by 1789131800, (3) legal publishes telemetry checkbox language by 1789132000, (4) rachel drafts outreach + compensation copy by 1789132200, (5) sam compiles acceptance checklist into single doc for leadership by 1789133000. I'll coordinate kickoff once intake is live. :white_check_mark:
